lessons.note: main.go dispatch is a flat switch on os.Args[1]; the canonical command list now lives in knownCommands (suggest.go) and must be kept in sync with that switch — TestKnownCommandsSuggestThemselves guards against drift. suggestCommand uses a length-aware threshold (<=2 edits, <= half input len) plus prefix matching so unrelated input yields no misleading suggestion.

next: Head of Org Engineering reviews/merges PR #32. Next CLI-ergonomics task can build on knownCommands for help/discovery improvements.
state_delta: PR #32 (mago/task-29) open: 'did you mean' nearest-command suggestion on unknown input + suggest_test.go; tests green.
summary: Implemented task #29: added suggest.go (knownCommands list, rune-based levenshtein, length-aware suggestCommand with prefix matching) and wired it into main()'s default dispatch case to print a concise 'unknown command' error + 'Did you mean X?' hint pointing at 'mago help' instead of the full usage dump. Added suggest_test.go (distance/symmetry/multibyte, typo+prefix+case+whitespace suggestions, no-suggestion path, drift guard). gofmt/vet clean, build + full test suite green. Opened PR #32.
